title: Linux Privilege Escalation Playbook
detail:
Order:
1. sudo -l (check GTFOBins for abusable binaries; env_keep can be used to hijack LD_PRELOAD)
2. SUID: find / -perm -4000 2>/dev/null (GTFOBins)
3. Scheduled tasks: /etc/cron* + crontab -l; writable scripts executed as root
4. Capabilities: getcap -r / 2>/dev/null (cap_setuid, etc.)
5. Writable PATH/sudo configuration/SSH keys
6. Kernel CVEs by version: DirtyCow (4.8-), DirtyPipe (5.8-5.16.11/5.15.25-), PwnKit polkit, OverlayFS
7. If inside a container, check the container escape entry first
Information-gathering script: linpeas.sh (keep an offline copy with the repository).
